programs.title: Secrets in the Ice
programs.desc: A top-secret military base hidden deep in the ice beyond the Arctic Circle is one of the Cold War's most elaborate cover-ups; recently declassified documents reveal its deadly purpose; the threat it might still pose to all humankind.

programs.title: Deadly Science
programs.sub_title: Ahead of Their Time (Galileo, Hypatia, Giordano Bruno)
programs.desc: A look at great thinkers who have left their mark on scientific discovery.

programs.title: I Died... And Came Back
programs.desc: An attempt at taking her own life leads to one woman's encounter with an afterlife she never expected; a regular visit to the DMV leads to an out-of-body experience that transports a woman into another dimension.

programs.title: Mapping Disaster
programs.desc: What happens when humanity does not prepare for the worst that Mother Nature can unleash, and how people can better prepare for the disasters of the future.

programs.title: Ghosts Off Grid
programs.desc: The ghost hunters trek to Calgary's historic Inglewood neighborhood and the Alexandra Centre, a sturdy three-story sandstone building with a highly haunted history; they're given a tour and tips by another ghost hunter.

programs.title: Quest for the Lost Vikings
programs.desc: As planning for a northern expedition continues, the Farm Heim team starts testing the gear they will use in their bigger quest. Meanwhile, Jo, Johann, and David set out for Berens River, a place with potential clues of Lost Vikings.
